<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1292
Claimant:
Brad Flores
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-09-17
First notice of loss received by phone from the claimant, who reports a low-speed collision while backing out of a
space in a parking lot. The claimant sattes they have no attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly.
2024-11-10
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of the reported incident. Nothing
in the policy history suggests any change in coverage before the loss.
2024-11-24
Reviewed the photos submitted by the claimant. They confirm the general location of the impact and the position of
the vehicles, though they do not show the moment of contact.
2024-11-30
Obtained the responding officer's report, which confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene. No
independent witnesses were identified on the report or during follow-up calls.
2024-12-03
Inspected the vehicle. The damage pattern and location are consistent with the impact described by the claimant, and
the estimate was prepared on that basis.
2025-01-14
Checked prior claim and damage records for the vehicle. No earlier damage has been recorded, and the claimant has
not mentioned any previous incidents.
2025-01-18
Spoke with the claimant about the injury. They report a wrist fracture from bracing against the steering wheel. The
injury description is in line with the kind of force expected from this type of collision.
2025-01-29
Requested medical records. The treating provider documented a wrist fracture and a course of care typical for that
injury. No prior inujry to the same wrist or arm appears in the records received so far.
2025-02-22
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Visits were frequent early on and became less frequent as the claimant's condition
improved, which matches the usual recovery pattern for this injury.
2025-03-11
Took a recorded follow-up call with the claimant. The account of how the collision happened matched the account
given at first notice, including the sequence of events and the location in the lot.
2025-04-20
Compared the claimant's statements across all contacts to date, including the phone call, the written statement, and
the follow-up call. The account has remained consistent throughout.
2025-05-03
Reviewed the file as a whole. The injury, vehicle damage, and driver information all line up with the reported incident,
and the claim is proceeding to settlement review pending final medical bills.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
